author: krashboy
quote: Honestly, I can't help feeling a bit disappointed with GTA 6. After waiting this many years, I expected something that would completely blow me away. The world looks amazing and the attention to detail is crazy, but the actual gameplay hasn't impressed me as much as I hoped. Some missions feel like a chore, the pacing is slow, and the gunplay just doesn't feel right. I also miss the old GTA humor and attitude. Everything feels a little too safe and politically cautious at times, with some of the feminist and social commentary feeling forced rather than natural. I wanted the usual Rockstar satire that makes fun of everyone, not something that feels like it's holding back. Even the 30 FPS cap is frustrating. It's still a decent game, but honestly, after all the hype and years of waiting, I expected so much more. The graphics alone aren't enough to make it a masterpiece.

quote: I never got to finish the original when I was younger. Great feeling to finish it finally and super satisfying. Kudos to the team who made this, you can tell care was put into the remake. Will be replaying multiple times and also when my kid is old enough will be playing together.
